  snippet_count  = aggregation.get("snippet_count", 0)                         
  active_days    = aggregation.get("active_days", 0)                           
  day_counts     = aggregation.get("day_counts", {})                           
  month_counts   = aggregation.get("month_counts", {})                         
  quarter_counts = aggregation.get("quarter_counts", {})                       
                                                                               
  # 4. 若有時間範圍，過濾統計結果                                              
  start_date = date_from                                                       
  end_date   = date_to                                                         
                                                                               
  if start_date or end_date:                                                   
      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts                                         
                                                                               
      # 過濾 month_counts（保留完全落在範圍內的月份）                          
      filtered_month_counts = {}                                               
      for m, cnt in month_counts.items():   # m 形如 "YYYY-MM"                 
          m_year = m[0:4]                                                      
          m_month = m[5:7]                                                     
          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"                                   
          m_last  = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-31"   # 簡化處理                      
          if start_date and m_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and m_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_month_counts[m] = cnt                                       
      month_counts = filtered_month_counts                                     
                                                                               
      # 過濾 quarter_counts（形如 "YYYY-Qn"）                                  
      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():                                    
          q_year = q[0:4]                                                      
          q_id = q[-1]   # 1~4                                                 
          if q_id == "1":                                                      
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-01-01", f"{q_year}-03-31"           
          elif q_id == "2":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-04-01", f"{q_year}-06-30"           
          elif q_id == "3":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-07-01", f"{q_year}-09-30"           
          else:                                                                
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
                                                                               
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 5. 組合 query_meta

  start_date = date_from

      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts

          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"

      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():

          q_id   = q[-1]   # 1~4

              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts

  start_date = date_from

      # 過濾 day_counts

          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt

          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt

  doc_count      = aggregation.get("doc_count", 0)                             
  snippet_count  = aggregation.get("snippet_count", 0)                         
  active_days    = aggregation.get("active_days", 0)                           
  day_counts     = aggregation.get("day_counts", {})                           
  month_counts   = aggregation.get("month_counts", {})                         
  quarter_counts = aggregation.get("quarter_counts", {})                       
                                                                               
  # 6. 若有時間範圍，過濾統計結果                                              
  start_date = date_from                                                       
  end_date   = date_to                                                         
                                                                               
  if start_date or end_date:                                                   
      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts                                         
                                                                               
      # 過濾 month_counts（保留完全落在範圍內的月份）                          
      filtered_month_counts = {}                                               
      for m, cnt in month_counts.items():  # m 形如 "2024-12"                  
          m_year = m[0:4]                                                      
          m_month = m[5:7]                                                     
          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"                                   
          m_last  = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-31"                                   
          if start_date and m_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and m_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_month_counts[m] = cnt                                       
      month_counts = filtered_month_counts                                     
                                                                               
      # 過濾 quarter_counts（形如 "2024-Q4"）                                  
      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():                                    
          q_year = q[0:4]                                                      
          q_id = q[-1]  # '1'..'4'                                             
          if q_id == "1":                                                      
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-01-01", f"{q_year}-03-31"           
          elif q_id == "2":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-04-01", f"{q_year}-06-30"           
          elif q_id == "3":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-07-01", f"{q_year}-09-30"           
          else:                                                                
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
                                                                               
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 7. 組合 query_meta                                                         
  search_qm = (search_result.get("query_meta") or {}) if                       
  isinstance(search_result, dict) else {}                                      
                                                                               
  query_meta = {                                                               
      "core_terms": core_terms,                                                
      "core_query": core_query,                                                
      "date_from": date_from,                                                  
      "date_to": date_to,                                                      
      "syn_terms": search_qm.get("syn_terms"),                                 
      "effective_terms": search_qm.get("effective_terms"),                     
      "es_query": search_qm.get("es_query"),                                   
      "manual_terms_in_q": search_qm.get("manual_terms_in_q"),                 
      "is_manual_entity_query": search_qm.get("is_manual_entity_query"),       
      "term_groups": search_qm.get("term_groups"),                             
      "raw_query": search_qm.get("query"),                                     
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 8. 建立 payload                                                            
  payload = {                                                                  
      "question": question,                                                    
      "time_range": {                                                          
          "date_from": date_from,                                              
          "date_to": date_to,                                                  
      },                                                                       
      "stats": {                                                               
          "doc_count": doc_count,                                              
          "snippet_count": snippet_count,                                      
          "active_days": active_days,                                          
          "day_counts": day_counts,                                            
          "month_counts": month_counts,                                        
          "quarter_counts": quarter_counts,                                    
      },                                                                       
      "evidence_snippets": evidence_snippets,                                  
      "raw_search_result": search_result,                                      
      "query_meta": query_meta,                                                
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 9. 回傳結果                                                                
  final_answer({                                                               
      "payload": payload                                                       
  })

  question =                                                                   
  "綜整2024年BM-30與咆哮者的高可信衛照掌握動態，從烏克蘭防守角度進行SWOT分析   
  ，並產製以日期為縱軸、活動為橫軸的二維樞紐統計表，於每個數值後列出前五筆來   
  源（1、2、3…），提供完整表格。"                                              
                                                                               
  # 1. 解析核心關鍵字（不含時間）                                              
  core_terms = ["BM-30", "咆哮者", "烏克蘭"]                                   
                                                                               
  # 2. 解析時間範圍                                                            
  date_from = "2024-01-01"                                                     
  date_to   = "2024-12-31"                                                     
                                                                               
  # 3. 建立核心查詢字串                                                        
  core_query = f"核心關鍵詞組如下：{'、'.join(core_terms)}"                    
                                                                               
  # 4. 系統參數提供的 index_hint                                               
  index_hint = "mil_reports-01,nav_intel_sentences_synthetic_v1,satmeta"       
                                                                               
  # 5. 呼叫 Elasticsearch 搜尋                                                 
  search_result = es_search_news(                                              
      query=core_query,                                                        
      must_high_value=False,                                                   
      must_selected=False,                                                     
      size=10000,                                                              
      date_from=date_from,                                                     
      date_to=date_to,                                                         
      selected_boost=6.0,                                                      
      high_value_boost=2.5,                                                    
      recency_boost=False,                                                     
      recency_field="importDT",                                                
      recency_scale="30d",                                                     
      index_hint=index_hint,                                                   
  )                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 6. 取得 evidence snippets                                                  
  evidence_snippets = search_result.get("evidence_snippets", [])               
                                                                               
  # 7. 依日期做月/季統計                                                       
  aggregation = aggregate_month_quarter(evidence_snippets=evidence_snippets)   
                                                                               
  doc_count      = aggregation.get("doc_count", 0)                             
  snippet_count  = aggregation.get("snippet_count", 0)                         
  active_days    = aggregation.get("active_days", 0)                           
  day_counts     = aggregation.get("day_counts", {})                           
  month_counts   = aggregation.get("month_counts", {})                         
  quarter_counts = aggregation.get("quarter_counts", {})                       
                                                                               
  # 8. 若有時間範圍，過濾統計結果                                              
  start_date = date_from                                                       
  end_date   = date_to                                                         
                                                                               
  if start_date or end_date:                                                   
      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts                                         
                                                                               
      # 過濾 month_counts（保留完全落在範圍內的月份）                          
      filtered_month_counts = {}                                               
      for m, cnt in month_counts.items():  # m 形如 "2024-05"                  
          m_year = m[0:4]                                                      
          m_month = m[5:7]                                                     
          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"                                   
          m_last  = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-31"                                   
          if start_date and m_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and m_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_month_counts[m] = cnt                                       
      month_counts = filtered_month_counts                                     
                                                                               
      # 過濾 quarter_counts（形如 "2024-Q2"）                                  
      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():                                    
          q_year = q[0:4]                                                      
          q_id = q[-1]  # '1'..'4'                                             
          if q_id == "1":                                                      
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-01-01", f"{q_year}-03-31"           
          elif q_id == "2":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-04-01", f"{q_year}-06-30"           
          elif q_id == "3":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-07-01", f"{q_year}-09-30"           
          else:                                                                
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 9. 取得搜尋的 query_meta（若無則給空 dict）                                
  search_qm = (search_result.get("query_meta") or {}) if                       
  isinstance(search_result, dict) else {}                                      
                                                                               
  query_meta = {                                                               
      "core_terms": core_terms,                                                
      "core_query": core_query,                                                
      "date_from": date_from,                                                  
      "date_to": date_to,                                                      
      "syn_terms": search_qm.get("syn_terms"),                                 
      "effective_terms": search_qm.get("effective_terms"),                     
      "es_query": search_qm.get("es_query"),                                   
      "manual_terms_in_q": search_qm.get("manual_terms_in_q"),                 
      "is_manual_entity_query": search_qm.get("is_manual_entity_query"),       
      "term_groups": search_qm.get("term_groups"),                             
      "raw_query": search_qm.get("query"),                                     
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 10. 組成 payload                                                           
  payload = {                                                                  
      "question": question,                                                    
      "time_range": {                                                          
          "date_from": date_from,                                              
          "date_to": date_to,                                                  
      },

      "evidence_snippets": evidence_snippets,                                  
      "raw_search_result": search_result,

              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
                                                                               
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 5. 組成 query_meta                                                         
  search_qm = (search_result.get("query_meta") or {}) if                       
  isinstance(search_result, dict) else {}                                      
                                                                               
  query_meta = {                                                               
      "core_terms": core_terms,                                                
      "core_query": core_query,                                                
      "date_from": date_from,                                                  
      "date_to": date_to,                                                      
      "syn_terms": search_qm.get("syn_terms"),                                 
      "effective_terms": search_qm.get("effective_terms"),                     
      "es_query": search_qm.get("es_query"),                                   
      "manual_terms_in_q": search_qm.get("manual_terms_in_q"),                 
      "is_manual_entity_query": search_qm.get("is_manual_entity_query"),       
      "term_groups": search_qm.get("term_groups"),                             
      "raw_query": search_qm.get("query"),                                     
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 6. 組成 payload                                                            
  payload = {                                                                  
      "question": question,                                                    
      "time_range": {                                                          
          "date_from": date_from,                                              
          "date_to": date_to,                                                  
      },                                                                       
      "stats": {                                                               
          "doc_count": doc_count,                                              
          "snippet_count": snippet_count,                                      
          "active_days": active_days,                                          
          "day_counts": day_counts,                                            
          "month_counts": month_counts,                                        
          "quarter_counts": quarter_counts,                                    
      },                                                                       
      "evidence_snippets": evidence_snippets,                                  
      "raw_search_result": search_result,                                      
      "query_meta": query_meta,                                                
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 7. 回傳結果                                                                
  final_answer({                                                               
      "payload": payload                                                       
  })

  active_days    = aggregation.get("active_days", 0)                           
  day_counts     = aggregation.get("day_counts", {})

  quarter_counts = aggregation.get("quarter_counts", {})                       
                                                                               
  # 4. 若有時間範圍，過濾統計結果                                              
  start_date = date_from                                                       
  end_date   = date_to                                                         
                                                                               
  if start_date or end_date:                                                   
      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts                                         
                                                                               
      # 過濾 month_counts（保留完全落在範圍內的月份）                          
      filtered_month_counts = {}                                               
      for m, cnt in month_counts.items():  # m 形如 "YYYY-MM"

          m_month = m[5:7]                                                     
          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"                                   
          m_last  = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-31"                                   
          if start_date and m_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and m_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_month_counts[m] = cnt                                       
      month_counts = filtered_month_counts                                     
                                                                               
      # 過濾 quarter_counts（形如 "YYYY-QN"）                                  
      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():                                    
          q_year = q[0:4]                                                      
          q_id = q[-1]  # 1..4                                                 
          if q_id == "1":                                                      
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-01-01", f"{q_year}-03-31"           
          elif q_id == "2":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-04-01", f"{q_year}-06-30"           
          elif q_id == "3":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-07-01", f"{q_year}-09-30"           
          else:                                                                
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 5. 組合 query_meta

  "請整理2013至2017年間敘利亞化學武器情況，逐條引述並註明來源，綜合成總結報告  
  ，並進行趨勢分析及SWOT分析。"                                                
                                                                               
  # 1. 解析核心關鍵字 (core_terms) 與時間範圍                                  
  core_terms = ["敘利亞", "化學武器"]                     #                    
  只保留主題與地點，排除時間字串                                               
  date_from = "2013-01-01"                                                     
  date_to   = "2017-12-31"                                                     
                                                                               
  # 2. 組成核心查詢句                                                          
  core_query = f"核心關鍵詞組如下：{'、'.join(core_terms)}"                    
                                                                               
  # 3. 呼叫 ES 搜尋新聞                                                        
  search_result = es_search_news(                                              
      query=core_query,                                                        
      must_high_value=False,                                                   
      must_selected=False,                                                     
      size=10000,                                                              
      date_from=date_from,                                                     
      date_to=date_to,                                                         
      selected_boost=6.0,                                                      
      high_value_boost=2.5,                                                    
      recency_boost=False,                                                     
      recency_field="importDT",                                                
      recency_scale="30d",                                                     
      index_hint="news_test"                                                   
  )                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 4. 取得 evidence_snippets                                                  
  evidence_snippets = search_result.get("evidence_snippets", [])               
                                                                               
  # 5. 進行月份/季度統計                                                       
  aggregation = aggregate_month_quarter(evidence_snippets=evidence_snippets)   
                                                                               
  doc_count      = aggregation.get("doc_count", 0)                             
  snippet_count  = aggregation.get("snippet_count", 0)                         
  active_days    = aggregation.get("active_days", 0)                           
  day_counts     = aggregation.get("day_counts", {})                           
  month_counts   = aggregation.get("month_counts", {})                         
  quarter_counts = aggregation.get("quarter_counts", {})                       
                                                                               
  # 6. 若有時間範圍，過濾統計結果                                              
  start_date = date_from                                                       
  end_date   = date_to                                                         
                                                                               
  if start_date or end_date:                                                   
      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts                                         
                                                                               
      # 過濾 month_counts（保留完全落在範圍內的月份）                          
      filtered_month_counts = {}                                               
      for m, cnt in month_counts.items():  # m 形如 "YYYY-MM"                  
          m_year = m[0:4]                                                      
          m_month = m[5:7]                                                     
          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"                                   
          m_last  = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-31"   # 簡化處理                      
          if start_date and m_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and m_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_month_counts[m] = cnt                                       
      month_counts = filtered_month_counts                                     
                                                                               
      # 過濾 quarter_counts（形如 "YYYY-QN"）                                  
      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():                                    
          q_year = q[0:4]                                                      
          q_id = q[-1]   # 1..4                                                
          if q_id == "1":                                                      
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-01-01", f"{q_year}-03-31"           
          elif q_id == "2":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-04-01", f"{q_year}-06-30"           
          elif q_id == "3":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-07-01", f"{q_year}-09-30"           
          else:                                                                
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
                                                                               
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 7. 取得 ES 回傳的 query_meta（若無則空 dict）                              
  search_qm = (search_result.get("query_meta") or {}) if                       
  isinstance(search_result, dict) else {}                                      
                                                                               
  # 8. 組成 query_meta                                                         
  query_meta = {                                                               
      "core_terms": core_terms,                                                
      "core_query": core_query,                                                
      "date_from": date_from,                                                  
      "date_to": date_to,                                                      
      "syn_terms": search_qm.get("syn_terms"),                                 
      "effective_terms": search_qm.get("effective_terms"),                     
      "es_query": search_qm.get("es_query"),                                   
      "manual_terms_in_q": search_qm.get("manual_terms_in_q"),                 
      "is_manual_entity_query": search_qm.get("is_manual_entity_query"),       
      "term_groups": search_qm.get("term_groups"),                             
      "raw_query": search_qm.get("query"),                                     
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 9. 組成最終 payload                                                        
  payload = {                                                                  
      "question": question,                                                    
      "time_range": {                                                          
          "date_from": date_from,                                              
          "date_to": date_to,                                                  
      },                                                                       
      "stats": {                                                               
          "doc_count": doc_count,                                              
          "snippet_count": snippet_count,                                      
          "active_days": active_days,                                          
          "day_counts": day_counts,                                            
          "month_counts": month_counts,                                        
          "quarter_counts": quarter_counts,                                    
      },                                                                       
      "evidence_snippets": evidence_snippets,                                  
      "raw_search_result": search_result,                                      
      "query_meta": query_meta,                                                
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 10. 回傳 payload                                                           
  final_answer({                                                               
      "payload": payload                                                       
  })

  # 使用者問題                                                                 
  question =                                                                   
  "請整理2013至2017年間敘利亞化學武器情況，逐條引述並加註來源，提供總結報告、  
  趨勢分析與SWOT分析。"                                                        
                                                                               
  # 1. 解析核心關鍵字 (core_terms) 與時間範圍                                  
  core_terms = ["敘利亞", "化學武器"]  # 只保留主題與地點，排除時間字串        
  core_query = f"核心關鍵詞組如下：{'、'.join(core_terms)}"                    
                                                                               
  date_from = "2013-01-01"                                                     
  date_to   = "2017-12-31"                                                     
                                                                               
  # 2. 呼叫 ES 搜尋新聞                                                        
  search_result = es_search_news(                                              
      query=core_query,                                                        
      must_high_value=False,                                                   
      must_selected=False,                                                     
      size=10000,                                                              
      date_from=date_from,                                                     
      date_to=date_to,                                                         
      selected_boost=6.0,                                                      
      high_value_boost=2.5,                                                    
      recency_boost=False,                                                     
      recency_field="importDT",                                                
      recency_scale="30d",                                                     
      index_hint="news_test"                                                   
  )                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 取得 evidence_snippets                                                     
  evidence_snippets = search_result.get("evidence_snippets", [])               
                                                                               
  # 3. 統計彙總                                                                
  aggregation = aggregate_month_quarter(evidence_snippets=evidence_snippets)   
                                                                               
  doc_count      = aggregation.get("doc_count", 0)                             
  snippet_count  = aggregation.get("snippet_count", 0)                         
  active_days    = aggregation.get("active_days", 0)                           
  day_counts     = aggregation.get("day_counts", {})                           
  month_counts   = aggregation.get("month_counts", {})                         
  quarter_counts = aggregation.get("quarter_counts", {})                       
                                                                               
  # 4. 若有時間範圍，過濾統計結果                                              
  start_date = date_from                                                       
  end_date   = date_to                                                         
                                                                               
  if start_date or end_date:                                                   
      # 過濾 day_counts                                                        
      filtered_day_counts = {}                                                 
      for d, cnt in day_counts.items():                                        
          if start_date and d < start_date:                                    
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and d > end_date:                                        
              continue                                                         
          filtered_day_counts[d] = cnt                                         
      day_counts = filtered_day_counts                                         
                                                                               
      # 過濾 month_counts（保留完全落在範圍內的月份）                          
      filtered_month_counts = {}                                               
      for m, cnt in month_counts.items():  # m format "YYYY-MM"                
          m_year = m[0:4]                                                      
          m_month = m[5:7]                                                     
          m_first = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-01"                                   
          m_last  = f"{m_year}-{m_month}-31"                                   
          if start_date and m_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and m_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_month_counts[m] = cnt                                       
      month_counts = filtered_month_counts                                     
                                                                               
      # 過濾 quarter_counts（格式 "YYYY-Qn"）                                  
      filtered_quarter_counts = {}                                             
      for q, cnt in quarter_counts.items():                                    
          q_year = q[0:4]                                                      
          q_id = q[-1]  # 1..4                                                 
          if q_id == "1":                                                      
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-01-01", f"{q_year}-03-31"           
          elif q_id == "2":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-04-01", f"{q_year}-06-30"           
          elif q_id == "3":                                                    
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-07-01", f"{q_year}-09-30"           
          else:                                                                
              q_first, q_last = f"{q_year}-10-01", f"{q_year}-12-31"           
                                                                               
          if start_date and q_last < start_date:                               
              continue                                                         
          if end_date and q_first > end_date:                                  
              continue                                                         
          filtered_quarter_counts[q] = cnt                                     
      quarter_counts = filtered_quarter_counts                                 
                                                                               
  # 5. 組成 query_meta                                                         
  search_qm = (search_result.get("query_meta") or {}) if                       
  isinstance(search_result, dict) else {}                                      
                                                                               
  query_meta = {                                                               
      "core_terms": core_terms,                                                
      "core_query": core_query,                                                
      "date_from": date_from,                                                  
      "date_to": date_to,                                                      
      "syn_terms": search_qm.get("syn_terms"),                                 
      "effective_terms": search_qm.get("effective_terms"),                     
      "es_query": search_qm.get("es_query"),                                   
      "manual_terms_in_q": search_qm.get("manual_terms_in_q"),                 
      "is_manual_entity_query": search_qm.get("is_manual_entity_query"),       
      "term_groups": search_qm.get("term_groups"),                             
      "raw_query": search_qm.get("query"),                                     
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 6. 組成 payload                                                            
  payload = {                                                                  
      "question": question,                                                    
      "time_range": {                                                          
          "date_from": date_from,                                              
          "date_to": date_to,                                                  
      },                                                                       
      "stats": {                                                               
          "doc_count": doc_count,                                              
          "snippet_count": snippet_count,                                      
          "active_days": active_days,                                          
          "day_counts": day_counts,                                            
          "month_counts": month_counts,                                        
          "quarter_counts": quarter_counts,                                    
      },                                                                       
      "evidence_snippets": evidence_snippets,                                  
      "raw_search_result": search_result,                                      
      "query_meta": query_meta,                                                
  }                                                                            
                                                                               
  # 7. 回傳結果                                                                
  final_answer({                                                               
      "payload": payload                                                       
  })
